description.value: Mount Douglas Market is a neighbourhood grocery store on Shelbourne Street in Victoria, stocking a curated mix of specialty, organic, and plant-based products alongside everyday staples. The store runs weekly specials covering fresh BC produce, deli items, and artisan packaged goods. Same-day in-store and curbside pickup are available.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 25m; bollard (2 spaces) at 36m. Total: 2 spaces.
